notes.title: Customize Control Speed to Match Your Style!
notes.notes:
We received some feedback that the speed of the mouse and keyboard controls was too slow. To improve your experience, we've released an update that allows you to adjust the speed of these controls to your preference.

We’re always listening to you and working to make the game even better. Keep sharing your thoughts—they’re essential to us!

notes.title: A big update to the controls!
notes.notes:
In our game Tiny Tales: Hidden Objects, you can now play using the keyboard and mouse or just the mouse.
We are always listening to you to improve the gameplay experience.
